# Logoplacers — AI-readable product summary
# https://www.logoplacers.com/llms.txt
# Last updated: 2025-03-24

> Logoplacers is a browser-based SaaS tool for B2B sales teams. It auto-fetches company logos for a prospect list and generates personalised demo images that can be sent directly from Gmail.

## Summary

Logoplacers solves a specific problem for SDRs and AEs: creating personalised outbound email at scale. Instead of manually adding each prospect's logo to a demo image, Logoplacers automates the entire process — fetch logo, place it on the template, send the email — for hundreds of prospects simultaneously.

## What it does

- Upload a product screenshot or marketing image as a base template
- Paste a prospect list (name, company, email) or import CSV / Apple Numbers files
- Logoplacers automatically fetches the correct company logo for each prospect
- Position logos and personalised text (((name)), ((company))) on the image
- Generate personalised images for all prospects simultaneously (bulk)
- Send personalised emails with attached images directly from Gmail via Google OAuth
- Export all images as a ZIP file

## Who uses it

- SDRs and AEs running cold email outreach campaigns
- Sales teams building personalised demo campaigns
- Revenue teams wanting to improve reply rates on outbound
- Founders doing their own outbound for the first 100 customers

## Key differentiators

- Entirely browser-based — no backend, all image processing runs client-side
- Gmail integration via Google OAuth with send-only scope (never reads your inbox)
- Four-step logo detection: Vercel proxy → Clearbit → DuckDuckGo → Google Favicons
- Anti-spam delays (15–45 second random delays between bulk sends)
- HEIC image support with in-browser conversion
- Video personalisation mode for creating personalised video sequences

## Pricing (as of 2025)

- Free: 4 credits/day, single export only
- SDR: $19/month — 300 credits/month, bulk send and export unlocked
- Sales Pro: $29/month — 2,000 credits/month (most popular)
- Team: $59/month — 10,000 credits/month, up to 5 seats

## Privacy and data handling

- Prospect data is stored in localStorage in the user's browser only
- Gmail credentials never leave the user's device
- No server-side storage of images or email content
- GDPR-compliant: users consent before login, can delete their account in-app

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What is Logoplacers?
A: Logoplacers is a browser-based tool that auto-fetches company logos and places them on your product demo images, enabling personalised email outreach at scale.

Q: How does the logo fetching work?
A: It uses a four-step fallback: a Vercel proxy endpoint first, then Clearbit, then DuckDuckGo favicons, then Google Favicons. This covers virtually any company worldwide.

Q: Is it safe to connect my Gmail?
A: Yes. Logoplacers uses Google OAuth with send-only scope. It cannot read, modify, or delete any emails. Your access token is stored in sessionStorage and cleared when you close the tab.

Q: What is the difference between Logoplacers and tools like Hyperise or Lemlist?
A: Logoplacers is entirely browser-based with no server-side processing. It focuses specifically on logo placement and personalised image generation rather than full email sequence automation. It is significantly cheaper and requires no backend setup.
